name: Jinma
summary: Jinma is a Zhongshan manufacturer of amusement equipment and cultural tourism products. It is extending its mechanical engineering, electrical control and attraction operations into embodied robotics for theme parks, scenic areas and commercial venues. Its controlled Jinma Matrix venture, established with Shanghai Matrix, develops humanoid visitor-service products including Xiaoma 1.
